nodes.name: Nickel electrodeposition on brass
nodes.procedure: Before electrodeposition, the electrode surfaces were polished with emery paper (1000 grit size), then washed with distilled water, thoroughly degreased with acetone, washed again with distilled water and immersed in the bath solution. The chemical composition of plating bath and deposition conditions are given in Fig. 1. The surface of brass was coated with nickel... B/Ni electrodes were obtained. The average thickness of the deposits was about 10 μm.
nodes.source_text: Before electrodeposition, the electrode surfaces were polished... The surface of brass was coated with nickel... The average thickness of the deposits was about 10 μm.

nodes.name: NiZn alloy electrodeposition on brass
nodes.procedure: Before electrodeposition, the electrode surfaces were polished with emery paper (1000 grit size), then washed with distilled water, thoroughly degreased with acetone, washed again with distilled water and immersed in the bath solution. The chemical composition of plating bath and deposition conditions are given in Fig. 1. The surface of brass was coated with nickel–zinc... B/NiZn electrodes were obtained. The average thickness of the deposits was about 10 μm. The thickness of the NiZn deposit was calculated by assuming an average alloy density of 7.5 g cm⁻³ and an average atomic weight of 60 g mol⁻¹.
nodes.source_text: Before electrodeposition... The surface of brass was coated with nickel–zinc... The thickness of the NiZn deposit was calculated...

nodes.name: Sequential Ni/NiZn electrodeposition on brass
nodes.procedure: Before electrodeposition, the electrode surfaces were polished with emery paper (1000 grit size), then washed with distilled water, thoroughly degreased with acetone, washed again with distilled water and immersed in the bath solution. The chemical composition of plating bath and deposition conditions are given in Fig. 1. The surface of brass was coated with nickel (under layer)/nickel–zinc (top layer)... B/Ni/NiZn electrodes were obtained. The average thickness of the deposits was about 10 μm.
nodes.source_text: Before electrodeposition... The surface of brass was coated with nickel (under layer)/nickel–zinc (top layer)... The average thickness of the deposits was about 10 μm.

nodes.name: Zn leaching from NiZn coatings
nodes.procedure: The B/NiZn and B/Ni/NiZn electrodes were immersed in a 30% NaOH solution at room temperature during 24 h, and more active zinc metal dissolved to obtain more porous electrodes.
